description: Search finished Polish public tenders (submission deadline passed) — e.g. similar past tenders to price an offer. A tender matches when it contains every word of the query in any inflection (title, contracting authority, CPV, description); recently finished tenders close in meaning are added. Optional filters: CPV code, voivodeship, estimated value, submission-deadline range. Returns paginated tender cards, each with a public URL; their award results (winner, price, number of offers) come from get_tender_results. Few results: try fewer or other words. Tenders without an AI summary are included (has_summary=false). `mode` is 'semantic' when the meaning search took part, 'lexical' otherwise; `unapplied_filters` lists filters a temporary fallback could not apply.

cpv.description: Restrict to tenders whose CPV includes this code

deadline_after.description: ISO date; only tenders with submission deadline after it

deadline_before.description: ISO date; only tenders with submission deadline before it

query.description: Words to find, e.g. 'spotkanie mikołajkowe dla dzieci'

region.description: Voivodeship (województwo): slug or name from list_facets, e.g. 'slaskie' or 'śląskie'

name: search_archived_tenders
title: Szukaj zakończonych przetargów
